self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Secret Wisdom's Favor: Charged Attack hits grant Elemental Mastery +80 for 6s, max 2 stacks (0.5s internal CD); modeled at max stacks (EM +160).

en.flavor: A golden bow forged from the description in the story. If you use it as a normal weapon, you can also view it as a part of a fictional world that has made it off the pages.

refinements.1: The character's Elemental Mastery will increase by <r>40</r> within 6s after Charged Attacks hit opponents. Max 2 stacks. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

fr.flavor: Un arc en or forgé à partir de la description d'une histoire. Si vous l'utilisez comme une arme normale, vous pouvez également le considérer comme faisant partie d'un monde fictif sorti de ses pages.
